about: Experience Pinball Heroes™ originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Enjoy some frantic ball flippin’ fun with addictive gameplay, simple controls and unique pinball tables.

Anyone can play Pinball Heroes thanks to the easy to grasp controls and variety of viewing options. It might be easy to pick up and enjoy, but it takes real skill – and maybe the odd cheeky table tilt – to keep your ball in play and activate all of a table’s special features.

This title has been converted from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Pinball Heroes™ originally released on the PSP™ (PlayStation®Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
